layoutCapabilities.adaptiveMetrics: derive layout metrics from bounds, size classes, safe areas, Dynamic Type, keyboard state, and orientation instead of copying one screenshot's absolute coordinates

adaptiveLayoutRules: Treat the source screenshot as one viewport sample, not as the only target size.
Page-level horizontal padding must come from the target app's existing layout tokens or neighboring screens before using screenshot-measured margins.
Fixed navigation, close, back, tab, and floating controls must be constrained to the root view safeAreaLayoutGuide or a fixed overlay container, not inside scroll content.
Generate a small metrics policy for substantial screens: compact width, regular width, short height, regular height, landscape, Dynamic Type accessibility categories, and keyboard-present states.
Preserve minimum touch targets of 44 pt while adapting visual size, spacing, and content insets across devices.
Use max/min, proportional width caps, intrinsic content size, and remade constraints for layout changes instead of one fixed chain of top offsets.
When the runtime device differs from the source device, optimize hierarchy, proportions, and readability over exact pixel distances from the source screenshot.

visualFidelityRules.rule: When a Figma icon appears next to text, preserve the wrapper bbox and inner graphic visual center separately. Align the icon wrapper to the source bbox, then align the visible icon center to the text optical center or recorded Figma y-center. Do not place icons by ad hoc x/y offsets from label baseline heuristics.
visualFidelityRules.rationale: Figma icon wrapper nodes can include padding and inner vectors that are not centered on the exported image bounds. UIKit code that uses UIImageView frames or custom UIBezierPath centers without wrapper/inner bbox evidence can drift relative to adjacent UILabel text, especially for small credit star/sparkle icons.
requiredChecks: For each icon+text pair, record icon wrapper bbox, inner graphic bbox, label bbox, horizontal gap, and centerY delta from the source image or Figma node data.
For custom CoreGraphics/UIBezierPath icons, draw around the source-derived visual center rather than a guessed center from the label origin.
For UIImageView icons, set explicit frame/constraints from the wrapper bbox; use contentMode center or centerInside when the exported image includes wrapper padding.
During simulator review, crop each icon+text pair and compare icon center, label bounding box, and gap before declaring visual parity.
